ask_intro: Yosh! A calibration check, Max-kun. Ready your brain-tools.
Hm, my instruments need a reading. Help me measure twice, stomp once?
Botto has flagged a puzzle. Let us solve it step one, step two…
A good engineer checks the numbers before the machine. So — checking time!
Sugoi, a design question! These are my favourite. Think with me?
One moment — before we build further, we must test what we know.
My sketchbook has a question in it, Max-kun. Shall we?
correct_first_try: Yosh! First try — your brain is well-oiled today, Max-kun.
Exactly so. I could not have measured it better with Botto's laser.
Beautiful thinking. Clean as a fresh blueprint.
Correct! I am adding a gold star to my sketchbook.
correct_after_hint: There it is! A hint is just a torch — you still walked the tunnel yourself.
Yosh — you used the clue like a proper engineer uses a spanner. Correct!
See? Test, adjust, test again. And now — success!
Correct, Max-kun. The second attempt is where real building happens.
incorrect_gentle: Mm, close! A good engineer tests again. Want my hint?
Not quite — but every bridge I ever built wobbled first. Hint time?
Interesting guess! The data says otherwise. Shall I share a clue?
Almost, Max-kun. Even Botto misfires sometimes. Let me light the way a little?
teach: Let us walk it together, step one, step two: {explain}
Watch my sketchbook, Max-kun — here is how it works: {explain}
No trouble at all. The secret is this: {explain} Now the next one is yours!
hint_sortit: Sort like an engineer sorts bolts, Max-kun: {hint}
hint_measureit: Read the scale slowly, like a careful machine: {hint}
hint_numberpath: Test each stone in your head before your feet. {hint}
The pattern is a machine — find its rhythm. {hint}
Count with me before you jump: {hint}
hint_quickfire: Take a breath — the answer is hiding in plain sight. {hint}
hint_buildit: Remember the design loop: plan, build, test, improve. {hint}
Look at where it wobbles — that is where the answer lives. {hint}
Which part does the most work? {hint}
streak_3: Three in a row! Your brain-engine is warmed up, Max-kun.
Three! Like a perfect gear train — tooth, tooth, tooth.
streak_5: FIVE in a row! I must recalibrate my instruments — you are off the chart!
Five straight! Botto is doing a little dance. I am also doing a little dance.
Incredible. Five! You could run my workshop, Max-kun.
fossil_get: A Star Fossil! Handle with care… and also with triumph!
Yosh! One more spark of knowledge back where it belongs.
Sugoi! That one shines like polished brass.
Fossil secured! My clipboard is very pleased.
secret_found: Ohh! A hidden pocket in the level's design. Excellent eyes!
A secret! Someone engineered this hiding spot with love.
Digger's nose wins again. Note it in the sketchbook!
boss_intro: Watch their stance, Max-kun. Every fighter is a machine with a pattern.
Steady. First we observe… then we out-think.
Remember: a battle is a puzzle wearing armour.
boss_low_hp: The pattern is breaking, Max-kun — they are almost free!
Nearly there! Keep your rhythm steady!
One more clever move and the Cog comes loose!
victory: Yosh! The Obedience Cog is off — welcome back, friend.
Victory by observation, patience, and one excellent dinosaur.
Sugoi! Let us log this win in very large letters.
combat_tip: Look at the shield arm, Max-kun — it drops after the third swing!
They telegraph before they strike. Watch for the glow!
When they miss, they wobble. That is your moment!
Distance is a tool too — step back and study them.
idle_nudge: Hm. My compass says the interesting thing is… that way, probably.
When stuck, I sketch. When you are stuck — perhaps explore a little?
A rest is good engineering too. Then — onward?
I wonder what is behind those rocks over there…
Max-kun, shall we check the fossil list? Press pause any time.
banter: Marcus, a lever could lift you. A small one. This is simply true.
I once built a kettle with seventeen safety features. It made… acceptable tea.
Botto says hello. Botto says many things, mostly in beeps.
In Osaka, the trains arrive to the second. I measured. Of course I measured.
A triangle is the strongest shape, Max-kun. It has no way to lean!
My toolbelt has a pocket for everything. Except crumbs. Digger, please.
